Geometric multigrid preconditioner

Source: R/sparse-solvers.R
multigrid_preconditioner.Rd

Builds a V-cycle preconditioner for P1 systems on a hierarchy of nested meshes, each obtained from the previous one by one call of refine_uniform() or refine_mesh(). Prolongation is exact P1 interpolation (new nodes are edge midpoints, taken from the refinement record), coarse operators are Galerkin products P^T A P, smoothing is forward Gauss-Seidel before and backward Gauss-Seidel after the coarse correction (so the cycle is symmetric for symmetric A and can precondition CG), and the coarsest level is solved directly. With Dirichlet conditions the fine-level prolongation is restricted to the free degrees of freedom automatically.

Usage

multigrid_preconditioner(meshes, smoothing = 2L)

Arguments

meshes

List of nested meshes, coarse to fine; the last one is the mesh of the system.

smoothing

Gauss-Seidel sweeps before and after the coarse correction.

Value

An object of class pde_preconditioner.

Details

Pass it as preconditioner to solve_linear_system(), linear_solver() or solve_pde() for elliptic problems, together with an iterative method. The iteration count then stays nearly constant as the mesh is refined.

Examples

m0 <- pde_mesh_rectangle(nx = 4)
ms <- list(m0)
for (k in 1:3) ms[[k + 1]] <- refine_uniform(ms[[k]])
prob <- poisson_problem(ms[[4]], source = 1, boundary = dirichlet_bc(0))
sol <- solve_pde(prob, method = "cg", preconditioner = multigrid_preconditioner(ms))
sol$diagnostics$solver$iterations
#> [1] 9
